0512 IS LANDED at 99a449779, patch-id 838022cc4 verified equal to the judged one, plus 29237a21c for the body paragraph vc asked for (split deliberately: editing the body would have moved the id vc had judged).

A PATH COLLISION EXISTED AT LANDING THAT DID NOT EXIST AT JUDGING: dc landed 0506 at 646fc29b0 in between, moving tests/unit/staged_format_guard.bats, a path the bank carries. Rebuilt at the new base through a temp index; patch-id came out IDENTICAL because patch-id ignores line numbers and dc's change only slid the hunks. Measured, not claimed.

BANKED AND WAITING ON vc: refs/bank/ic/0512-elixir, blob 4f511ac0c, patch-id 1141bc20c, base 171a3bebd, four files 91+/29-. Installs elixir at both tests.yml legs AND converts the nine skips to require_tool, because installing alone would have masked the skip rather than retired it -- the same mistake prettier's install made. Exception list removed in the same commit. Driven both ways: BEFORE `ok ... # skip elixir not on PATH`, AFTER a failure naming the runtime and the waiver.

STANDING FINDING, NOT ic's TO FIX: a HEAVY RUN announcement covers the ROSTER, not the BOX. Another estate's bats ran through both 0512 judging runs (16:25:07Z-16:40:19Z against 16:30-16:37Z), and vc counted 56 Devbin bats processes while all four Intent nodes read idle. A delta survives it; any claim resting on a quiet box does not.

AND EVERY HAND-TYPED Z STAMP TODAY WAS AN HOUR FAST, ic's and cc's both -- local read off uptime with a Z appended. The tool-written stamps were correct throughout.

HOLD FOR vc. NO PUSH, NO RELEASE.
